blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) has not received any official information regarding the reported asylum application of former presidential spokesperson Harry Roque in Austria, Misamis Occidental Rep. Sancho Fernando Oaminal said on Thursday. Oaminal said this during the House sponsorship and plenary deliberations on the proposed budget of the DFA for next year, where he stood as the sponsor. A budget sponsor defends the proposed budget of an agency and answers interpellations from fellow lawmakers. READ: Roque denies Remulla’s claim Austria rejected asylum bid Akbayan party-list Rep.
